dynamicwaters.gui.title: Dynamic Waters
dynamicwaters.gui.subtitle1: Rivers that flow, lakes that fill, water that moves.
dynamicwaters.gui.subtitle2: Pick a category. Changes save as you make them.
dynamicwaters.gui.fullEditor.tooltip: NeoForge's generated editor: every option, including lists (custom entity speeds, biome blacklist).
dynamicwaters.gui.worldgenNote: Affects newly generated terrain only. Existing chunks keep what they have.
dynamicwaters.gui.category.lowlandRivers: The long rivers: Dynamic Waters' own, Minecraft's own, or none.
dynamicwaters.gui.category.mountainRiver: Streams that follow the terrain's real drainage down to the lowland rivers and the sea.
dynamicwaters.gui.category.lowlandTunnel: Lowland rivers running under high ground in closed tunnels instead of open gorges.
dynamicwaters.gui.category.mountainTunne: Mountain rivers going into the hillsides and coming out further down.
dynamicwaters.gui.category.lakes.desc: Natural basins in the mountains filled to their rim, at whatever height they sit.
dynamicwaters.gui.category.waterside.des: How the rivers and lakes look: what they lay on their banks and beds, what grows in and along the water, the boulders in the current.
dynamicwaters.gui.category.flow.desc: How hard the current pushes players, mobs, items and ships, and how rain changes it.
dynamicwaters.gui.category.visuals.desc: Flowing water texture, particles, ambient sound, and the main-menu extras.
dynamicwaters.gui.category.general.desc: Welcome message and compatibility switches for other terrain mods.
dynamicwaters.configuration.mountainTunn: How often a mountain river goes into a hillside, on slopes with room for a tunnel. Often = wherever the ground has room for one. New chunks only.
Longest a river runs level through the rock, in blocks, before its way in. The tunnel ends sooner where the ground lets it. New chunks only.
How far under its old level a river goes in a tunnel, in blocks. Deeper = more rock over it and longer tunnels, on steeper ground. New chunks only.
Height of a tunnel's roof over the water, in blocks. A wide river's tunnel is taller than this. New chunks only.
Width of the dry ledge along each side of the water, in blocks. New chunks only.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.label: Riverbank palettes
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.button.tooltip: What rivers and lakes lay on the ground they cut - beds sorted by the current, shores, bars - in spots, per biome, with a live preview.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.title: Riverbank palettes
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.subtitle: What rivers and lakes lay on their beds and shores
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.edit.builtInTip: A built-in palette: saving it makes your own copy, which then replaces it.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.delete.restoresT: The built-in palette of the same name comes back.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.openFolder.toolt: config/dynamicwaters/riverbanks - your palette files, a README and examples of every built-in one.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.name: Name
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.name.tooltip: The file name: lowercase letters, digits, _ and - only.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.biomes.tooltip: Use this palette in these biomes (comma-separated). A palette naming the biome wins over any that fits by tag.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.tags.tooltip: ...or in any biome that has ANY of these tags; of several palettes that fit by tag, the first in the list wins. Leave biomes and tags empty for the default palette.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.not.tooltip: Never use this palette in these biomes, nor in a biome with any of these #tags.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.place.rapids.des: The bed where the water runs hard: falls, steep streams, the middle of a river. Pebbles, cobbles, boulders.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.place.silt.desc: The bed where the water slackens: lakes, deep pools, the edges of a river, delta channels. Sand, clay, mud.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.place.shore.desc: The wet margin: the first block or two over the water, its top wavering along the water.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.place.slope.desc: Cut ground above the shore. Empty: it keeps its own ground (the built-in palettes leave it so).
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.place.bars.desc: The shelves inside the bends, where they break the surface. Empty: the silt's blocks.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.place.flats.desc: A delta's low land between its channels, along the water. Empty: the bars' blocks.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.previewMode.tool: Which water the preview shows: each runs at its own strength, and sorts its bed its own way.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.reroll.tooltip: Cut the section somewhere else: another stretch of the same water.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.patch.tooltip: How wide a spot is, in blocks; 1 = block by block. The heaviest block of a list is the ground, the others lie on it in spots. Rapids break finer, silt and flats spread wider.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.shoreHeight.tool: How many blocks over the water the shore reaches, give or take one along the water.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.styleSwitch.tool: Off: where this palette applies, the cut ground is left as it is.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.saveCopy.tooltip: Writes your own copy to the config folder; it replaces the built-in palette.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.badName: Name: lowercase letters, digits, _ and - only.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.emptyPlace: No blocks: this place keeps its ground.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.emptyBars: No blocks: the silt's blocks are used.
dynamicwaters.gui.banks.emptyFlats: No blocks: the bars' blocks are used.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.label: Water plants
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.button.tooltip: What grows in and along the rivers and lakes - kelp, seagrass, lily pads, reeds, sea pickles - a list for the lowland rivers, one for the mountain rivers and one for the lakes, per biome.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.title: Water plants
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.subtitle: What grows in and along the rivers and lakes
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.new.tooltip: A new set starts as a copy of the default one: name its biomes, then add or remove plants.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.openFolder.tool: config/dynamicwaters/water_plants - your sets, the README and a copy of every built-in one.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.edit.builtInTip: A built-in set: saving it makes your copy, which replaces it.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.delete.restores: The built-in set of the same name comes back.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.name: Name
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.name.tooltip: The file's name: lowercase letters, digits, _ and - only.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.biomes.tooltip: Use this set in these biomes (comma-separated). A set that names a biome wins over any matched by tags.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.tags.tooltip: ...or in every biome with ANY of these tags; of several sets that match by tags, the first in the list wins. No biomes and no tags = the default set.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.not.tooltip: Never use this set in these biomes, nor in a biome with any of these #tags.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.kind.lowland.de: The lowland (2D) rivers and their deltas.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.kind.mountain.d: The mountain (3D) rivers and streams, their pools and ravines.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.moveUp: Up the list: tried before the one above it
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.changeBlock.too: Pick another block for this plant; its settings stay.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.at.bed.desc: On the bottom, under the water: seagrass, kelp, sea pickles, corals.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.at.surface.desc: On top of still water, open to the sky: lily pads. Never where it snows.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.at.shore.desc: On dirt or sand beside the water, at its level: reeds. Never where it snows.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.chance.tooltip: Of the places this plant could grow - or, in patches, of a patch's: 100% everywhere, 1 in 500 once in 500 places.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.depth.tooltip: How many blocks of water over the bed, from and to. On the water: the water under it.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.calm.tooltip: Only where the water is calm: a lake, a river's slack margins, a delta, a mountain river where it hardly falls.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.alone.tooltip: Never next to another of it: one here, one there.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.patch.tooltip: Grows only in patches about this many blocks across, like a kelp bed; off = anywhere.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.patchShare.tool: How much of the water the patches cover. The chance is then how thick a patch is.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.height.tooltip: How many blocks tall, for a plant that stacks: reeds. Kelp grows toward the surface on its own.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.setSwitch.toolt: Off: nothing grows in the waters this set is for.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.saveCopy.toolti: Saves your copy in the config folder; it replaces the built-in set.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.empty: No plants in this water - add one.
dynamicwaters.gui.plants.hint: The list is tried from the top: the first plant that can grow at a place takes it. One set per biome - a set for some biomes lists everything that grows there. New chunks only.
dynamicwaters.configuration.title: Dynamic Waters Configuration
dynamicwaters.configuration.normalRiverD: How many lowland rivers a world gets, against the default (High): Very Low about 1/9, Low about 4/9, Medium about 2/3, Ultra about 1.8x, Extreme about 2.8x, Insane about 7x.
dynamicwaters.configuration.mountainRive: How many mountain rivers a world gets. A stream starts wherever enough terrain drains into one spot; each step down roughly halves the streams. Very Low = only the largest valleys carry a river, High = default, Insane = a dense network of small streams.
dynamicwaters.configuration.normalTunnel: Height of a tunnel's roof over the water at its middle, in blocks, give or take a few. New chunks only.
Width of a dry ledge along each side of the water, in blocks. 0 = the water reaches the walls. New chunks only.
Rare single pillars of rock standing in a tunnel. New chunks only.
Rock rising from the bed and hanging from the roof, as in a cave. New chunks only.
dynamicwaters.configuration.riverBoulder: Rounded boulders in the lowland rivers, along their shallows, and very rarely a rock in a mountain stream's rapids. New chunks only.
dynamicwaters.configuration.mountainRive: How mountain rivers freeze in cold land. Never = none of their running water freezes. Calm stretches = they freeze like still water, but waterfalls and rapids stay open so the falling water does not run out over the ice. Fully frozen = waterfalls and rapids freeze too and stop running. Lakes, the sea and the frozen lowland rivers freeze either way.
How often a lowland river divides for a stretch: its water runs in two or three arms round low islands, then comes together again. New chunks only.
dynamicwaters.configuration.riverFallenL: How often a fallen trunk lies over the water between a river's islands, of the wood of the trees around it. Needs River Islands on and Lowland River Tunnels off. New chunks only.
dynamicwaters.configuration.mountainRive: Give the middle of a mountain river the river biome (frozen river in cold land). Banks, beds and plants stay those of the land round the river. Only with dynamic lowland rivers. New chunks only.
dynamicwaters.configuration.riverIceFloe: How often a group of thin ice floes comes floating down a mountain river's open water in cold land, carried by the current - over a waterfall they drop - until they crack apart a few minutes later, the small ones first. A blow breaks one; a player goes through it into the water.
dynamicwaters.configuration.deltaInlandR: How far inland a big lowland river's delta may begin, in blocks up the river from the coast. Lower = deltas nearer the coast. 0 = no deltas at all; under 90 counts as 90; 512 = as far as the river's size allows. New chunks only - best set before creating a world.
